heroes.name: Super Zayd
heroes.tagline: Every maze has a way out. Let's find it together!
heroes.imageAlt: Super Zayd raising a fist, wearing a teal and gold suit, a blue mask and a blue cape with golden maze lines
powers: Maze-Sight: his eyes glow gold and show every path, shortcut and secret door
Compass Cape: glides on warm air like a giant paper kite
Wayfinder Star: a throwing star that turns into a glowing signpost wherever it lands
heroes.personality: Brave, kind and a tiny bit too fond of puns. Zayd never leaves a teammate behind, even when that teammate is busy eating the last pancake.
heroes.catchphrase: Left, right, or straight ahead — Guardians, let's go!
funFacts: Can solve a hedge maze blindfolded. Cannot find his left sneaker in the morning.
Keeps a map of every maze he has ever solved in a scrapbook under his bed.
Invented the team's high-five: it's shaped like a Z.

heroes.name: Dragoncrest
heroes.tagline: Three heads are better than one. Usually.
heroes.imageAlt: Dragoncrest, a big friendly figure in grey armour whose helmet carries three little green dragons
powers: Stretch-Punch: his armoured arm stretches around corners to bonk trouble from far away
Crest Lookout: Flicker, Flame and Fluff — the three helmet dragons — can watch three hallways at once
Warm Breath: the dragons puff toasty sparks that melt ice (and toast marshmallows)
heroes.personality: The biggest Guardian and the softest heart. He says sorry to doors before he walks through them.
heroes.catchphrase: Special delivery — one Stretch-Punch, coming around the corner!
funFacts: The three helmet dragons argue about lunch every single day.
Fluff is afraid of butterflies. Flame is not afraid of anything. Flicker is mostly sleepy.
First drawn in the Guardians' Art Vault as a giant with a three-dragon crest.

heroes.name: Arrowlight
heroes.tagline: I never miss. And when I do, I make a bridge.
heroes.imageAlt: Arrowlight in a blue hood and suit drawing a glowing cyan bow
powers: Light Arrows: arrows made of sunshine that never hurt anyone
Bridge Shot: an arrow that stretches into a glowing bridge across any gap
Signal Flare: a sparkly arrow that writes messages in the sky
heroes.personality: Calm, careful and secretly hilarious. Arrowlight practises archery every morning — on pancakes. (She gives them back.)
funFacts: Her bow folds up small enough to fit in a lunchbox.
She can write the whole alphabet in the sky with Signal Flares.
First spotted in the Art Vault battling a yeti with a blue bow.

heroes.name: Bubbleguard
heroes.tagline: Don't worry. I've got you covered — in bubbles.
heroes.imageAlt: Bubbleguard in an aqua suit and pink mask, arms raised inside a giant shimmering bubble
powers: Bubble Shield: a bouncy force-field bubble that nothing gets through
Boing-Back: anything that hits her bubble bounces right back where it came from
Bubble Taxi: carries friends safely across lava, rivers and very sticky jelly
heroes.personality: Thoughtful and super caring. She giggles when she's nervous, which makes everyone else feel less nervous too.
funFacts: Her bubbles smell faintly of bubblegum.
She once kept a whole picnic dry during a thunderstorm.
First seen in the Art Vault glowing in a bright blue shield.

heroes.name: Zigzag
heroes.tagline: Why go straight when you can go zig… and then zag?
heroes.imageAlt: Zigzag the speedster in a purple suit with a lightning-bolt emblem, running with a rainbow trail behind her
powers: Zig-Speed: runs so fast she sometimes arrives before she leaves
Rainbow Trail: leaves a colourful path so nobody gets lost following her
Wave Surfing: can surf on any wave — even ones made of jelly
heroes.personality: Bouncy, loud and always first in line for breakfast. She has never once walked anywhere.
funFacts: Eats 14 pancakes before breakfast. Then has breakfast.
Her goggles are for wind, not for looking cool. (They do look cool.)
First seen in the Art Vault zig-zagging through the snow.

villains.name: Grumblejaw
villains.tagline: ROOOAR! Everything is MINE! …Including that bolt. And that one.
villains.imageAlt: Grumblejaw, a grey junkyard robot beast with tank treads, red eyes, smoking ears and a huge underbite jaw
powers: Mega-Roar: a roar so loud it rattles maze walls
Junk Magnet: pulls in every bolt, spoon and bicycle bell nearby
Tank Treads: stomps straight through walls instead of walking around them
villains.scheme: Wants to scramble the Compass Core so every road in the Mazeverse leads to his junkyard.
villains.weakness: Gets distracted by shiny things. Also, he can't turn left very well.
villains.personality: Loud and grumpy, but mostly because nobody ever lends him a wrench.
villains.catchphrase: ROOOAR! …Has anyone seen my other bolt?
funFacts: Built himself out of a vending machine, two shopping carts and a toaster.
Was first spotted in the Art Vault crashing into a tower.

villains.name: Blizzardbyte
villains.tagline: Nobody escapes my ice maze! Brrr-ha-ha!
villains.imageAlt: Blizzardbyte, a big white yeti with an ice crown and glitchy coloured pixels in his fur
powers: Freeze Frame: turns maze paths into slippery ice
Snowball Storm: throws a hundred snowballs a minute
Glitch Hop: blips from one icy hallway to another
villains.scheme: Wants to freeze the whole Mazeverse into one giant ice maze where he is the only one who knows the way.
villains.weakness: Warm cocoa and warm hugs. He melts (emotionally).
villains.personality: Thinks he's the scariest thing in the Frost Fields. Actually just lonely.
funFacts: The coloured pixels in his fur are glitches. They tickle.
Was first spotted in the Art Vault facing the whole team in the snow.

villains.name: Splashfang
villains.tagline: Surf's up — and you're going DOWN the drain!
villains.imageAlt: Splashfang, a cheeky blue sea serpent with a spiky crest and one goofy fang
powers: Tidal Tantrum: whips up giant waves that wash maze paths away
Bubble Breath: blows bubbles that pop into puddles
Slip Slide: makes any floor as slippery as a water slide
villains.scheme: Wants to flood the Grape-Jelly Dunes so the whole Mazeverse becomes one big splash park — for him only.
villains.weakness: Hates being used as a surfboard. Ticklish under the chin.
villains.personality: Cheeky and splashy. Thinks every problem can be solved with a bigger wave.
funFacts: His single fang is a baby tooth. He's still waiting for the other one.
Was first spotted in the Art Vault carrying the whole team on his back by accident.

minions.name: Glitchlings
minions.description: Tiny pixel critters made of wobbly jelly code. They carry foam pool-noodle swords, shout "ATTACK!" a lot, and bounce harmlessly when bonked. Most of them just want snacks.
